name: Creamy Beet, Potato & Apple Soup with Crispy Prosciutto
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice beets and carrots. Place both in a large bowl.
Peel and small dice potatoes. Add to the bowl with the beets and carrot.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserve remaining parsley for garnish).
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until veggies are very tender, 10-12 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches, add the prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove prosciutto to a plate and set aside.
When the soup is done, remove from heat and add cream. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
Crumble or chop prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with crispy prosciutto and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
